name: carboxylic acid (fixture)
definition: A molecule that carries at least one carboxy group, i.e. a carbon doubly bonded to one oxygen and singly bonded to a second oxygen that itself carries one hydrogen (-C(=O)OH).

name: primary alcohol (fixture)
definition: A molecule that carries a hydroxy group on a carbon.

name: primary amine (fixture)
definition: A molecule that carries a nitrogen bonded to exactly one carbon and two hydrogens.

name: aldehyde (fixture)
definition: A molecule that carries a formyl group, i.e. a carbon doubly bonded to an oxygen and carrying one hydrogen.

name: ketone (fixture)
definition: A molecule that carries a carbonyl carbon bonded to two other carbons.

name: carboxylic ester (fixture)
definition: A molecule that carries a carbonyl carbon singly bonded to an oxygen that itself is bonded to a second carbon.

name: thioester (fixture)
definition: A molecule that carries a carbonyl carbon singly bonded to a sulfur.

name: nitrile (fixture)
definition: A molecule that carries a carbon triple-bonded to a nitrogen.
